recipes.name: Baked Chicken & Veggie Meatballs
recipes.notes:
Yields about 24-30 1-inch meatballs (age 6 months+).

1. Preheat oven to 400F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
2. Shred the carrots.
3. Chop the spinach.
4. Chop the green onion.
5. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and gently fold together until just incorporated; let sit 5 min.
6. Roll into 1-inch balls, wetting hands as needed.
7. Bake 15-20 min until cooked through and lightly browned.
8. Let cool and serve.
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
10. Store in the fridge up to 4 days or freezer up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Baked Cod with Lemon and Garlic
recipes.notes:
1. Preheat oven to 400F.
2. Mix lemon juice, olive oil, and melted butter in a shallow bowl (no garlic yet); set aside.
3. In another shallow bowl, mix flour, coriander, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper.
4. Pat fish dry, dip in the lemon sauce then the flour mixture, shaking off excess; reserve the remaining lemon sauce.
5. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a cast iron or oven-safe skillet over medium-high and sear fish about 2 min per side for color, then remove from heat.
6. Stir the minced garlic into the reserved lemon sauce and drizzle over the fish.
7. Bake until the fish flakes easily, about 10 min.
8. Sprinkle with parsley and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Baked Creamy Orzo with Chickpeas & Spinach
recipes.notes:
1. Preheat oven to 375F.
2. Add all ingredients except the lemon juice to a 9x13 casserole dish and stir well.
3. Cover tightly with foil and bake 30 min.
4. Stir, then bake uncovered another 15-20 min until the orzo is tender and creamy.
5. Finish with lemon juice and season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Black Bean–Quinoa Bowl
recipes.notes:
1. Combine ¾ cup beans (rinsed) and ⅔ cup quinoa in a bowl.
2. Stir ¼ cup hummus and 1 tablespoon lime juice together in a small bowl; thin with water to desired consistency.
3. Drizzle the hummus dressing over the beans and quinoa.
4. Top with avocado (diced), 3 tablespoons pico de gallo and 2 tablespoons cilantro.

recipes.name: Chicken Spaghetti with Burrata
recipes.notes:
1. Preheat oven to 400F.
2. Toss halved cherry tomatoes with 2 tbsp olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and pepper; spread on a parchment-lined sheet and roast about 20 min.
3. Slice each chicken breast in half horizontally and season with salt, smoked paprika, and Italian seasoning.
4. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium and cook chicken about 5 min per side until cooked through; remove and slice thinly.
5. In the same skillet, add lemon slices, garlic, and butter; cook a couple minutes over low-medium heat to release the lemon juice and soften the garlic, then remove the lemon slices.
6. Cook spaghetti per package instructions, drain, and toss with the lemon-butter-garlic skillet.
7. Top the pasta with sliced chicken and roasted tomatoes; divide burrata among plates and finish with chopped basil and toasted pine nuts.

recipes.name: Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.notes: 1. High heat, cook chicken first, vegetables second, sauce last.

recipes.name: Creamy au Gratin Potatoes
recipes.notes:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Grease a 2-quart casserole dish with butter.
2. Layer 1/2 of the potatoes in the bottom of the prepared casserole dish; season with salt and pepper.
3. Layer onion slices over top, then top with the remaining potatoes. Season again with salt and pepper.
4. Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in flour and salt; cook, whisking constantly, until the raw flour flavor has cooked off, about 1 minute.
5. Gradually add milk, about 1/4 cup at a time, whisking well after each addition to incorporate.
6. Cook, whisking constantly, until the mixture has thickened, 3 to 5 minutes.
7. Stir in cheese all at once; cook, stirring constantly, until melted, 30 to 60 seconds.
8. Pour cheese sauce over the potatoes, and cover the dish with aluminum foil.
9. Bake in the preheated oven until potatoes are tender and sauce is bubbly, about 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.name: Creamy Chicken Sausage Orzo Skillet
recipes.notes:
1. Cook sausage in olive oil over medium-high heat, 6-7 min, until browned.
2. Add garlic, saute 30 sec.
3. Add orzo, toast 60 sec.
4. Pour in broth to deglaze, then add coconut milk, soy sauce, seasonings, and thyme.
5. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat, and simmer 10-12 min, stirring occasionally, until orzo is tender and liquid is absorbed.
6. Stir in spinach until wilted, then mix in parmesan.
7. Season with extra salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Crockpot Chicken Tikka Masala Bowls
recipes.notes:
1. Cut chicken into chunks and dice the onion.
2. Combine chicken, onion, garlic, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, and the spices (garam masala through cayenne) in the crockpot.
3. Cook on low 6-7 hr (or high 3-4 hr) until the chicken is tender.
4. Stir in the coconut milk during the last 20 min to warm through.
5. Serve over rice (cooked separately — the sauce is too thick for raw rice to cook evenly in the pot), topped with cilantro.

Substitute: 3 tbsp store-bought garam masala blend in place of the individual spices if you want to skip measuring.

recipes.name: Crockpot Greek Chicken Meatballs with Creamy Tomato Orzo
recipes.notes:
1. Mix ground chicken, parmesan, shallot, 2 chopped garlic cloves, oregano, paprika, and balsamic vinegar in a bowl; season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes.
2. Roll into 15-16 tablespoon-size meatballs with oiled hands.
3. Drizzle with olive oil and place in the crockpot along with the cherry tomatoes, wine, 1/2 cup water, and the 6 whole garlic cloves.
4. Cover and cook on low 3-4 hr or high 1-2 hr.
5. Move the meatballs and garlic to a baking sheet.
6. Turn the crockpot to high, stir in the orzo and 1 cup water, cover, and cook 20-30 min until the orzo is al dente (add more water if it looks dry); stir in the cream.
7. Meanwhile, broil the meatballs and garlic 1-3 min until crisp.
8. Peel and chop the garlic, mix with the butter, rosemary, and thyme on the sheet pan, and toss the meatballs in it.
9. Serve the meatballs over the orzo with feta, basil, and dill.

recipes.name: Crockpot Taco Burritos
recipes.notes:
1. Cook ground beef first.
2. Then combine beef, onions, bell peppers, jalapeno, black beans, brown rice, broth, and the taco seasoning spices (chili powder through red pepper flakes) in the crockpot; cook until the rice is tender.
3. Warm tortillas, fill with the taco rice mixture, and top with feta.

Substitute: in place of the homemade seasoning spices, you can use 2 store-bought taco seasoning packets. Swap the garlic powder for onion powder if you prefer.

recipes.name: Garlicky Pesto Flatbread Pizza with Tomatoes and Arugula
recipes.notes:
1. Preheat oven to 425F.
2. Brush flatbreads with garlic puree and bake 3-5 min to crisp up.
3. Spread red pesto over flatbreads, top with mozzarella, chicken, and tomato slices, season with salt and pepper, and bake on a sheet pan 10-13 min until cheese is bubbling and edges are crisp.
4. Top with torn basil and balsamic glaze.
5. Slice and serve.

recipes.name: Greek Style Roasted Lemon and Garlic Chicken with Potatoes and Carrots
recipes.notes:
1. Preheat oven at 425 degrees Fahrenheit (220 degrees Celsius).
2. Rub salt and pepper into the chicken.
3. Push under the skin of each piece 1/4th piece of lemon and 2 garlic clove halves.
4. Place chicken on a large pan (large enough to fit potatoes and carrots in one layer).
5. Cut potato and carrots in smallish pieces 1 ½ -2 inches and put in a bowl along with sliced onion.
6. Add 4 tablespoon olive oil to the vegetables, pepper, and the oregano and mix well, until all vegetables are coated well.
7. Spread vegetables around the chicken.
8. Brush chicken generously with olive oil on both sides, roast skin facing up.
9. Roast for about 45 minutes-1 hour (if you are roasting a whole chicken it will take longer about a ½ hour more).
10. Check chicken, juices should be clear, although I prefer a meat thermometer, temperature at thickest part should be 165 F (74 C).
11. If chicken is done, but vegetables are not, remove chicken and cover with aluminum foil, and roast until vegetables are crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside.

recipes.name: Lemon Herb Salmon & Asparagus Sheet Pan
recipes.notes:
1. Preheat oven to 400F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
2. Toss asparagus with half the olive oil, salt, and pepper, and spread on one half of the pan.
3. Whisk the remaining olive oil, garlic, Dijon, juice of one lemon, dill/parsley, salt, and pepper.
4. Place salmon on the other half of the pan, spoon sauce over the fillets, top with capers, and lay slices from the second lemon over top.
5. Roast 12-15 min until salmon flakes easily and asparagus is lightly crispy.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Baked Crispy Chicken and Pasta
recipes.notes:
1. Stir together salt, pepper, chili powder, and smoked paprika.
2. Score the skin side of the chicken thighs, rub with the spice mix, cover, and refrigerate at least 2 hours (up to overnight); let sit out 20-30 min before cooking.
3. Preheat oven to 350F.
4. Sear chicken skin-side down in 1-2 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat about 3 min without disturbing it, then remove and set aside.
5. Add more olive oil and saute the onion, red pepper, and optional serrano about 3 min; add garlic and saute 1 min.
6. Stir in lemon zest, lemon juice, cumin, thyme, and white wine.
7. Return the chicken to the skillet, sprinkle in the feta, cherry tomatoes, and olives, and bake about 20 min until the chicken reaches 175F.
8. Meanwhile, boil the pasta 2 min short of package directions, reserving some pasta water.
9. Remove the chicken from the skillet, mash the remaining sauce ingredients together, and thin with pasta water as needed.
10. Toss in the cooked pasta, return the chicken to the skillet, and bake 5 more min until warmed through.
11. Season to taste and garnish with fresh herbs before serving.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Chicken with Sun-Dried Tomatoes & Artichokes
recipes.notes:
1. Season chicken with salt and pepper, then dredge in flour.
2. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high and brown the chicken about 4 min per side; remove to a plate.
3. Add artichokes, sun-dried tomatoes, capers, and lemon juice to the same skillet and stir over medium heat; reduce heat to medium-low and stir in the remaining 2-3 tbsp olive oil.
4. Push the vegetables to the sides, return the chicken to the skillet, cover, and cook over low-medium heat 5-10 more min until the chicken is cooked through.
5. Serve immediately, spooning the olive oil and vegetables over the chicken.

recipes.name: One-Pan Herb Roasted Pork Loin with Potatoes & Carrots
recipes.notes:
1. Preheat oven to 425F and pat pork dry.
2. Rub pork with a mix of Dijon, garlic, salt, and pepper.
3. Toss potatoes and carrots with olive oil, salt, and pepper directly in a roasting pan.
4. Sear pork on all sides in the remaining oil, about 2 min per side, then nestle into the vegetables.
5. Lay rosemary and thyme sprigs over top and pour chicken broth into the pan.
6. Roast uncovered 45-55 min until pork reaches 145F internal and vegetables are golden.
7. Rest pork 10 min before slicing; serve with pan juices.

recipes.name: One-Year Breastfeeding Cake (Vanilla Marshmallow "Boob Cake")
recipes.notes:
1. Preheat oven to 350F; grease and line two 8-9in round pans.
2. Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cream butter and granulated sugar 2-3 min until fluffy, then mix in egg whites and vanilla.
4. Alternate adding the flour mixture and milk in three additions, mixing just until combined.
5. Divide batter into pans and bake 25-30 min; cool completely.
6. For the filling, whip the cream with powdered sugar to soft peaks, then fold in marshmallow fluff and vanilla; chill.
7. Stack the cooled cakes, carve a center hole leaving about a 1in base, fill with marshmallow filling, and replace the top piece; carve into a smooth dome.
8. For the buttercream, beat the butter, then gradually add powdered sugar, milk/cream, vanilla, and a pinch of salt until fluffy.
9. Apply a thin crumb coat and chill 20-30 min, then frost smoothly into a dome shape.
10. Tint a small amount of frosting pink and pipe a circle in the center.
11. Refrigerate up to 3 days; bring to room temp before serving.

recipes.name: Shrimp Pesto Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes and Spinach
recipes.notes:
1. Halve the tomatoes.
2. Season the shrimp. Sprinkle the shrimp with a pinch each of salt, pepper, and baking soda, if you like. Toss to coat.
3. Boil the pasta. Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil. Cook the spaghetti until al dente according to package directions. Before draining, reserve about a cup of the pasta cooking water. Drain pasta through a colander, but don’t rinse, and set aside.
4. Sauté the shrimp. While the pasta cooks, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add them to the skillet in a single layer and cook for about 1 to 2 minutes per side, or until opaque and just cooked through. Transfer the shrimp to a plate and set aside.
5. Sauté the tomatoes. In the same skillet, lower heat to medium and add the remaining tablespoon of olive oil. Stir in the garlic and cook just until fragrant (about 30 seconds), then add the cherry tomatoes and a pinch of salt. Sauté for 2 to 3 minutes, or until the tomatoes soften somewhat. Add the spinach and stir to wilt. If using, stir in the red pepper flakes.
6. Combine and toss. Return the shrimp to the skillet along with the cooked pasta. Add the pesto and a splash of the reserved pasta water. Toss everything together gently to coat, adding more pasta water as needed to reach your desired consistency.
7. Finish and serve. Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt and pepper. Transfer to a serving bowl and top with grated Parmesan and torn basil, if desired.

recipes.name: Taco Night
recipes.notes:
1. Brown the beef with taco seasoning.
2. Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.

recipes.name: Tex-Mex Beef & Black Bean Casserole
recipes.notes:
1. Preheat oven to 375F.
2. Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet and cook onion until softened, about 4 min; add garlic and cook 1 min more.
3. Add beef and cook until browned, breaking it up, then drain fat and stir in taco seasoning.
4. Stir in black beans, corn, Rotel, and enchilada sauce; simmer 3-4 min.
5. Layer half the beef mixture, tortilla strips, and cheese in a 9x13 dish; repeat layers.
6. Bake uncovered 20-25 min until bubbly.
7. Rest 5 min, then serve with sour cream.

recipes.name: Turkey & Sausage Chili
recipes.notes:
1. Cook the ground turkey and sausage until browned, then combine with the onions, peppers, beans, tomatoes, and seasoning in a large pot.
2. Simmer until heated through and flavors meld.
